    • fromPairs

      @SafeVarargs public static <A,B> Map<A,B> fromPairs(Pair<A,B>... pairs)
      Return a map from a list of key/value pairs. If a key appears multiple times in the list, the last pair overrides the others.
      Type Parameters:
      A - the type of key
      B - the type of value
      Parameters:
      pairs - the list of key/value pairs
      Returns:
      a map from a list of key/value pairs
